# Cultivating Hope in Times of Sorrow

## Scripture
"But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint." Isaiah 40:31 (NIV)

## Reflection
As we navigate life's challenges, it's easy to lose sight of hope. Our circumstances can seem insurmountable, and our emotions can become overwhelming. But God's Word reminds us that hope is not just a feeling; it's a foundation rooted in Him. When we put our trust in the Lord, He renews our strength, giving us the endurance to face each day with faith and resilience. We don't have to rely on our own strength or emotions to carry us through; instead, we can draw on the power of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us. As we lean into God's presence, we'll find the strength to soar, to run, and to walk through life's trials with a sense of purpose and peace.

## Prayer
We pray, Lord, that You would be our rock, our refuge, and our source of hope in times of sorrow and uncertainty. Renew our strength and give us the endurance to face each new day with faith and resilience.

## One-Line Application
Hope is not just a feeling, but a foundation rooted in God's presence.
